content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Corvane Analytics is in breach of its Revenue to Plan covenant for the period ended October 31, 2026, with revenue at {{fact:d3c0308e-5362-4a2d-add5-7f48ba7438ce}} of plan against a required {{fact:2b1e9f12-88af-480c-8839-8321fdd53587}}. The Minimum Runway and Minimum Unrestricted Cash covenants are met, and the compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculations on each test, including the revenue breach. The breach has been decided for escalation to committee, so the decision on it now sits with committee. Headroom on both the revenue and cash covenants has narrowed each month since August."},{"section":"covenants","body":"Minimum Runway is compliant at {{fact:aa7e3900-d551-49f6-be00-77d22b097b20}} against a required {{fact:fa04558d-7ff5-413d-9a47-18adac3c3e30}}, a cushion of {{fact:564fc156-a5fb-4cec-99a4-90b1db4d7a22}}. The certificate reports {{fact:39ffe0c1-3361-4fcb-bc94-2228c84f512b}}, matching the bank. Minimum Unrestricted Cash is compliant at {{fact:dbd79489-2b03-4727-a834-ad64cbe6d2f4}} against a required {{fact:470a0286-54f6-4cc7-9317-4263d93d03ed}}, a cushion of {{fact:646000c5-6cea-46af-87a0-9d19e4f548b5}}. The certificate reports {{fact:3a1e18be-aca9-4ded-9f8b-b5837ee590cb}}, matching the bank. Revenue to Plan is in breach at {{fact:d3c0308e-5362-4a2d-add5-7f48ba7438ce}} against a minimum of {{fact:2b1e9f12-88af-480c-8839-8321fdd53587}}, a cushion of {{fact:143008c9-152b-4303-8b94-f0ec44e56200}}. The certificate reports {{fact:194229d5-2cee-41c8-a7b3-fc68f0dd8337}} and does not claim compliance, consistent with the bank's calculation."},{"section":"risks","body":"The most important item is the Revenue to Plan breach, a high-severity work item decided for escalation to committee. Medium-severity signals describe the same shortfall: revenue at {{fact:d3c0308e-5362-4a2d-add5-7f48ba7438ce}} of plan, and covenant headroom already below the threshold at {{fact:143008c9-152b-4303-8b94-f0ec44e56200}}. A low-severity signal shows revenue covenant headroom worsening in each month from August through October, indicating a deepening miss rather than a one-off timing issue. Another low-severity signal shows unrestricted cash headroom declining since August to {{fact:646000c5-6cea-46af-87a0-9d19e4f548b5}}, although cash of {{fact:dbd79489-2b03-4727-a834-ad64cbe6d2f4}} remains above the {{fact:470a0286-54f6-4cc7-9317-4263d93d03ed}} minimum. The facts held do not show the cause of the cash decline."}]}
